title: Marine Fitter / Engine Rating — Career Roadmap
summary: A Marine Fitter / Engine Rating supports the operation, inspection and maintenance of a ship’s machinery, pumps, valves, piping and auxiliary systems. The engine-room rating pathway is a merchant shipping career, not a defence-service role.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Marine Engineering / Fire & Safety

blocks.label: Recommended route
blocks.text: Class 10 with Science and Mathematics for the General Purpose (GP) Rating pathway; relevant ITI fitter training can provide an alternative route.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Physics, English, basic mechanics and electrical fundamentals.

blocks.label: Entrance / admission
blocks.text: Institute-specific admission and any applicable maritime selection process; check current Directorate General of Shipping (DG Shipping) rules.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Diesel engines, pumps, workshop tools, piping systems, engine-room safety and shipboard life.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Mechanical aptitude, teamwork, spoken English, physical readiness and safety discipline.
DG Shipping publishes GP Rating course guidance and eligibility rules. Requirements can change, so confirm current age, marks, medical fitness and course eligibility before applying.
PRE SEA COURSES (GP RATINGS)

items.text: GP Rating pre-sea course → Broad deck and engine-room foundation; subsequent sea service and certification requirements apply.
GP Rating for eligible ITI Fitters / Petty Officers → Potential route for candidates with the specified ITI background.
Relevant ITI Fitter / Mechanic training → Workshop skills before an eligible maritime pre-sea programme.
Diploma in Mechanical / Marine Engineering → Alternative technical foundation; does not automatically qualify a candidate for every engine-room rating position.
Fire & Safety diploma → Supplementary safety knowledge; not a substitute for mandatory maritime training or certificates.

blocks.text: The exact course and qualification route must match the intended shipboard job and applicable DG Shipping rules.

blocks.label: Rating progression
blocks.text: Engine Rating → Watchkeeping Rating → Able Seafarer–Engine, subject to applicable sea service, training and certification requirements.
A rating qualification is not equivalent to a marine engineering officer qualification.
